# Third-party fixture artwork — licences

Artwork in `fixtures/third-party/` was made by someone outside this project.
That is the point of it: our own drawings cannot tell an improvement from a
change tuned to them, so only these can decide that a change to the engine
helps a user's images (`docs/HARNESS.md`, "Who is allowed to decide that a
change is an improvement").

Everything here is redistributable, and every entry below was written by
`scripts/source-fixture.mjs` from the source's own metadata **before** the
file was downloaded — the tool refuses any licence not on its allowlist and
has no override.

These are IMAGES. No traced SVG from any other product is here, or ever
should be.
